en.headline: Hiker dies after collapsing on Plover Cove Reservoir Country Trail
en.dek: A 64-year-old Filipino man holding a Hong Kong identity card was found unconscious on the trail near Tai Po on Sunday afternoon and was certified dead while being airlifted; police are investigating whether heat…
body: Police received a report shortly before 2pm on Sunday that a man was lying unconscious on the Plover Cove Reservoir Country Trail in Tai Po. Government Flying Service helicopter and other rescuers responded and began transporting him to hospital, but he was certified dead during the transfer.

The deceased was identified as a 64-year-old Filipino man holding a Hong Kong identity card. He was wearing hiking attire; blood was found on his head and on a nearby rock. There were no signs of a struggle. Investigators estimated he had been dead for at least six hours before discovery by other hikers.

Police are examining whether heat-related illness contributed to the collapse amid the record-breaking temperatures recorded across Hong Kong on Sunday. The cause of death will be determined after an autopsy.

zh.headline: 大埔船灣郊遊徑男子暈倒 直升機送院途中不治
zh.dek: 周日下午一名64歲持香港身份證的菲律賓籍男子於船灣淡水湖郊遊徑被發現昏迷，飛行服務隊直升機送院途中證實不治，警方調查是否與中暑有關。
body: 警方周日下午近2時接報，一名男子倒卧大埔船灣淡水湖郊遊徑昏迷不醒。救援人員及飛行服務隊到場，以直升機送往醫院搶救，惟途中證實不治。
死者為64歲持香港身份證的菲律賓籍男子，身穿行山裝束，頭部流血，附近石頭亦有血跡，現場沒有打鬥痕迹。據估計事主被發現前已死去最少6小時。
警方正調查是否涉及中暑，死因有待驗屍後確定。當日本港多區錄得破紀錄高溫。
